item.title: India-Brazil $30 Billion Trade Target Explained: What Modi-Lula talks mean for minerals, steel and global trade?
item.description: India and Brazil are aiming big. After high-level talks in New Delhi, the two countries agreed to double bilateral trade to $30 billion by 2030 and signed key agreements on critical minerals, steel supply chains and digital cooperation.

item.title: ‘Made Us All Feel Ashamed’: Opposition Parties Slam Congress Over Shirtless Protest At AI Impact Summit 2026
item.description: A dramatic shirtless protest by Youth Congress workers at a major AI summit in Delhi has sparked outrage across political parties. Leaders from multiple sides condemned the disruption, calling it embarrassing for India on a global stage.

item.title: IMD forecasts warmer week ahead for Delhi-NCR; South India on heavy rain alert
item.description: According to the India Meteorological Department, North India is set for a warmer week with Delhi temperatures reaching 32°C and stronger sunshine increasing daytime heat. Uttar Pradesh and Bihar will see gradual warming, while light snowfall is expected in high-altitude Himalayan regions.

item.title: Pakistan launches airstrikes in Afghanistan; Claims 7 TTP bases targeted
item.description: Pakistan has claimed to carry out intelligence-based airstrikes in Afghanistan targeting seven hideouts of Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan (TTP) and allied groups. The operation reportedly followed recent deadly suicide attacks in Pakistan.

item.title: PM Narendra Modi to inaugurate full Delhi–Meerut Namo Bharat Corridor today; Details here
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi will inaugurate the full 82.15-km Delhi–Meerut Namo Bharat corridor, making the high-speed route fully operational. Built by National Capital Region Transport Corporation, the project will reduce travel time between Delhi and Meerut to just 55 minutes.

item.title: IND vs SA: Will rain disrupt T20 World Cup 2026 clash in Ahmedabad? Details here
item.description: India will face South Africa in a crucial Super 8 match of the T20 World Cup 2026 at Narendra Modi Stadium, Ahmedabad. Unlike the washed-out Pakistan vs New Zealand game in Colombo, weather forecasts predict clear skies and uninterrupted play.

item.title: Taliban vows retaliation after Pakistani airstrikes; Afghanistan reacts strongly
item.description: Afghan Taliban has warned of retaliation after Pakistan carried out midnight airstrikes targeting suspected hideouts of Tehrik-i-Taliban Pakistan (TTP) in eastern Afghanistan. Kabul accused Islamabad of violating its sovereignty and breaching the ceasefire agreement.

item.title: AI Impact Summit: Nandan Nilekani says India will lead Global AI diffusion; Details here
item.description: At the AI Summit CEO Roundtable, Nandan Nilekani highlighted how an idea proposed by Narendra Modi on applying AI to dairy farmers was implemented within three weeks through Amul.

item.title: Eight terror suspects arrested in Tamil Nadu and Bengal; Delhi Police to probe
item.description: Eight suspects were arrested from Tamil Nadu and West Bengal for allegedly plotting terror attacks with suspected links to Pakistan’s ISI and Bangladesh-based groups. Officials said digital evidence, including mobile phones and SIM cards, was seized.
